subject.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache

question: Should the gateway retain at most 4096 model-pricing rows using the proposed recency-preserving eviction policy when a refreshed catalog exceeds that limit?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible bounded-state repair, but the cap and eviction behavior intentionally change which large-catalog pricing rows remain cached; that product and operational tradeoff is not mechanically determined by the OOM report.

options.title: Accept 4096-entry LRU retention
options.body: Approve the proposed state-boundary cap after current-head proof confirms direct and normalized lookup behavior.

options.title: Choose a different retention contract
options.body: Keep this PR open for a revised bound or eviction rule if 4096 entries or LRU-style retention is not the desired gateway policy.

recommendation.title: Accept 4096-entry LRU retention
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed state-boundary cap after current-head proof confirms direct and normalized lookup behavior.
